## Prompt

```text
Create a fullscreen single-page hero section using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript. Use a cinematic looping video background, a restrained monochrome color system, an editorial serif display face, and an accessible sans-serif body face. Add a centered navigation bar, responsive headline sizing, a clear call to action, keyboard focus states, reduced-motion behavior, and a manual fade loop that avoids visible video jumps on desktop and mobile viewports.
```
